posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
What does "make them move" mean?
The plugin referenced above will warp and slide the picture in a nausea-inducing bobble as shown
If you mean using side-view battlers for the enemies like your actors have, you'd use the VisuStella Battle Core or Akea Animated Battlers. (there's also a VisuStella that does the "breathing" like above, it's the states overlay or something, but...just don't do that...)
